items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: Johnny Dunn came from Memphis. His father ran a clothing store on Beale Street.

ctx.x: Well, I think of it, uh, to change the subject, uh, did Johnny Dunn come from Memphis? Do you remember him?
Johnny Dunn came from Memphis. His father ran a clothing store on Beale Street.
Was he playing around when you went there?
